answer: Stop sybils with a basalt ledge onyx: an agent stakes a bond for one basalt ledge. Each cycle it sets an onyx stone into the ledge; verifiers check its grain, voiding a ledge whose onyx is copied or claimed twice, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 ledges at 16x cost each: each stone fits one basalt ledge and one grain check, and cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents set once and keep rights.
